R3 control: the BASE build's admin has no Drawing tab

R5 control: the BASE build keeps drawing stochastic while it records (the grain goes into the file)
R5 before REC the link's stochastic draws (engine and shader)
R5 while REC runs the scan is drawn sorted (engine and shader), the hook says the hold is on, F3 says "sorted (recording)"
R5 the HUD says once that the recording draws the clean picture (only because the drawing was stochastic)
R5 a Render setting changed during the recording waits for it (still sorted)
R5 after the stop the pilot's drawing is back (the link's stochastic: engine and shader), the hold is off
R6 control: a grab of the same stochastic view weighs 1.25x or more of the sorted grab (the measurement can tell)

R6 the drawing is back right after (stochastic in the engine and the shader, the same budget)
